title: Formalization of a sharp cone square-function estimate via superorthogonality
summary: This is a Lean 4 formalization of Theorems 1.1 and 1.4 from the paper "Diameter-free reverse inequalities and superorthogonality" by A. Cushman, C. Demeter and S. Wu. Theorem 1.1 is a reverse square-function estimate in L^4 under a superorthogonality hypothesis that is weaker than the Type IV superorthogonality of Gressman-Pierce-Roos-Yung. Theorem 1.4 applies a similar estimate to the three-dimensional light cone, yielding a refinement of the reverse cone square-function estimate of Guth-Wang-Zhang.
